title: Read the profit and loss
header_line: My analysis of one book on authority and personal brand. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Do you know what each line of your numbers says?

A student explained a profit and loss statement: it shows gross revenue, the income coming in, the top line, and below it the costs, down to the bottom line. The more detailed it is, the better you understand the business.

I asked: if a company has a million in gross sales and its net profit is negative, what are the only two ways back to profitability? Answer: decrease expenses or increase income. Within the statement you see where to focus.
Another student added: diversifying your products, or within one product, your strategy for bringing it to market, because there are infinite ways to produce more income.
I said that is literally your journey and the learning curve, and then it just becomes a habit; you find comfort in creating a process.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write your top line and your bottom line.
Write two ways to raise income.
Write two ways to cut cost.
Write when you review the statement.

check.q: What are the only two ways to fix a loss, in the student's example?

recap: Read the numbers line by line. Cut cost or raise income.
